{{Quote|This, Grand Admiral Thrawn, is power. This city&mdash;this planet&mdash;these people. Every human, Psadan, and Myneyrsh who live here are mine. ''Mine''.|Joruus C'baoth, to Thrawn|<ref name="HTTE" />}}
On the [[planet]] [[Wayland/Legends|Wayland]], the [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss]] established a '''city''' near [[Mount Tantiss/Legends|Mount Tantiss]] and forced the native [[Myneyrsh]], [[Psadan]], and [[Human/Legends|Human]] populations to build it.<ref name="TTTS" />

{{City-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The city first appeared in the opening chapter of ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', the first novel in [[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy|the Thrawn Trilogy]] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="HTTE" /> It was later depicted in the [[Heir to the Empire 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Heir to the Empire (comic series)|comic adaptation]] of ''Heir to the Empire'',<ref name="H1">[[Heir to the Empire 1|''Heir to the Empire'' 1]]</ref> and was mentioned in the ''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]'' published by [[West End Games]].<ref name="HTTES">''[[Heir to the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

The ''Heir to the Empire Sourcebook'' and ''[[The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook]]'' treat the [[Guardian of Mount Tantiss]] and [[Joruus C'baoth]] as the same character. They established that the Guardian had built the city.<ref name="HTTES" /><ref name="TTTS" /> A [[Psadan]] in the ''[[The Last Command]]'' mentions that Joruus C'baoth forced the native Myneyrsh, Psadan, and Human populations to live together beneath the shadow of Mount Tantiss.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> An [[in-universe]] [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] entry in the [[Voren Na'al's journal|journal]] of a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Historian/Legends|historian]] [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] titled "A Piece of History" featured in the ''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]'' and ''The Thrawn Trilogy Sourcebook'' explicitly mentions that, "apparently," according to the myths of Psadans and Myneyrshi, Joruus C'baoth had subjugated the population of Wayland, forcing them to build a small city at the base of Mount Tantiss. The entry mentions that New Republic historians have been unable to confirm these myths.<ref name="TLCS">''[[The Last Command Sourcebook]]''</ref><ref name="TTTS" />

The city was later referenced in [[1995]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]'',<ref name="The Essential Guide to Characters">''[[The Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> [[1998]]'s ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'',<ref name="Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|III||Wayland}}</ref> and the [[Databank (original)|original Databank]] entry "Wayland" on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="Wayland" /> However, none of these sources clarify who ordered the city to be built.
